messages:
priya: Ok everyone — kicking off the Optimize toolkit + evals scope thread. Customer asks keep coming in asking for batching/caching recommendations + automated regression alerts tied to prompt sets. Need a minimal launch plan and clear launch criteria by EOD Wed. Thoughts?

kenji: +1. We should separate infra recommendations (batch sizes, kv cache TTLs) from evaling quality regressions. Both need different owners.

dave: Proposed MVP (concise):
- batching profiler + suggested configs per model/seq-dist
- prefix/KV cache guidance + sample config for Redis/HW cache
- eval harness: curated prompt sets (small, medium) + baseline scoring
- regression alerting: delta on key metrics, sampling traces for triage
This keeps rollout small but useful.

elena: Concern: cost and risk. If we push caching defaults that increase memory on Hosted, ops will complain. Need canary and fallback rules (auto-disable cache if mem > X).

toby: For roadmap/OKR alignment, we need user stories + acceptance criteria. Quick draft: 
- As an engineer, I get a per-model batching config suggestion that reduces tokens/sec cost by >=10% without >20ms added P50 latency.
- As a SRE, I get alerts when regression delta >3% on eval prompts over 24h window.

kenji: For metrics, we should track: per-request token latency, batch formation latency, effective throughput, cache hit ratio, and eval metric deltas (BLEU/ROUGE/semantic-sim). Also collect a tiny sample of completions for human review.

priya: Agree. Can we sketch a minimal config snippet that customers could apply? Something that can go into docs and the console as a recommendation.

kenji: Sure, draft config (for docs/quickstart):
```yaml
optimize:
  batching:
    target_tokens: 512  # target tokens per batch
    max_latency_ms: 150
    burst_policy: conservative
  caching:
    kv_prefix_ttl_s: 30
    max_cache_entries: 10000
  evals:
    prompt_sets:
      - name: search-rerank
        size: 500
    regression_alert:
      metric: rouge_l
      delta_pct: 3
      window: 24h
```

dave: That looks good. Implementation notes: profiler needs ~2 weeks dev + 1 week infra to roll out on a low-traffic slice. Eval harness and prompt sets ~1 week to curate + 1 week to instrument scoring pipelines. Alerts: 3 days to wire metrics, 2 days to tune thresholds.

elena: Rollout plan idea:
- Week 1: internal dogfood on Dedicated pool (kenji)
- Week 2: canary on 1% Hosted traffic with cache disabled by default; opt-in flag in console (elena)
- Week 3: widen to 10% if no regressions; enable recommendations in Console docs (toby)

qa-bot: automated-test: nightly eval suite scheduled for 02:00 UTC, will post results to #optimize-evals-reports.

priya: Owners & immediate actions:
- kenji: batching profiler + docs snippet owner
- dave: eval harness, baseline prompt sets, alert wiring
- elena: rollout plan + canary infra + cost guardrails
- toby: customer-facing docs + quickstart examples
Can each owner add a brief GH epic this afternoon? :thumbsup:

kenji: I’ll open the profiler epic and include the sampling kit. ETA Tue PR for the snippet.

dave: I’ll draft prompt_set seeds and wire a prototype alert rule.

elena: Will set up canary policy and memory guardrails. Need a short SLA note for Hosted.

toby: I’ll draft the customer-facing FAQ + one-pager.

priya: Next sync: 30min Friday to lock launch criteria. Criteria candidates:
- profiler deployed to Dedicated + initial recommendations available
- eval harness runs nightly and detects no >3% regressions on stable prompt sets for 48h
- cost impact on Hosted < 5% for customers in canary
If we hit those, we consider GA-worthy for the first tranche.

dave: Suggest we add a human review gate for any regression alert before wide rollout to avoid noisy ops escalations.

elena: Agreed. Add a workflow: alert -> triage (human) -> rollback toggle.

priya: Perfect. Thanks all — please add your GH epics and link here. I’ll follow up with calendar invite for Friday sync. If anyone has customer examples/prompt sets to include, drop them in this thread or attach to the epic.
